profile_text.body:
Deere & Co is a public company headquartered in Moline, Illinois, and trades under the ticker DE. Its website describes it as offering agricultural, construction, and forestry machinery, technology, and services, and directs visitors to find a John Deere dealer in their area or to purchase online. The site's own summary of the business is limited to that description of machinery, technology, and services.

The material reviewed does not name any AI products or AI-specific offerings, and no products are tracked for the company in the data provided. The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000315189.

On litigation, the record shows 339 cases in Illinois. No lawsuits are individually listed, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
